{{Quote|You're White?''"<br />"''Tanner. White didn't make it. It's just me and Pauling, up in the cockpit.|Tanner, introducing himself to Trig Longo|<ref name="DT" />}}
'''Tanner''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] stationed aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the ''Vector''{{'s}} crew was exposed to a deadly [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] the afflicted and subsequently reanimated them as [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. Immune to the disease, Tanner and twenty-nine others sought shelter from the undead in a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] docked within the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], eventually resorting to cannibalism to stay alive. During their tenth [[Standard week/Legends|week]] inside the [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|shuttle]], they attempted to kill&mdash;and [[Diet/Legends|eat]]&mdash;[[Jareth Sartoris]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] from the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], who was fleeing from the horde of undead, before brokering a deal with him for escape. Sartoris disabled a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that had been preventing the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from fleeing as part of the arrangement, directing three fellow ''Purge'' survivors to the awaiting shuttle before he died. Tanner greeted the trio as they prepared to depart, but before the shuttle could get very far, he was killed by a zombie who had managed to board the craft.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There were thirty of us originally. Now we're down to seven, including myself.|Commander Gorrister, explaining the situation to Jareth Sartoris|<ref name="DT" />}}
Tanner was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] stationed aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]<ref name="DT" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the ''Vector'' [[Transport/Legends|transported]] containers of a deadly virus, codenamed "[[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]]," from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meglumine]] to an Imperial testing facility on the planet [[Khonji Seven]]. However, during the journey, a few of the containers were breached, exposing the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] crew to the virus. Most [[Death/Legends|died]] from the affliction&mdash;and were subsequently turned into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]&mdash;but a few were immune to the airborne disease, Tanner being one of them. As the virus spread throughout the ''Vector'', infecting its crew, Tanner and twenty-eight others, led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]], sought shelter in a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] docked within the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. However, the group was unable to flee the ''Vector'', for an active [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] prevented the [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|shuttle]] from departing. Rather than face the horde of undead, the soldiers confined themselves within the craft in an effort to stay alive.<ref name="DT" />

[[File:Zombie_trooper.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tanner was killed by a zombie stormtrooper (pictured).]]
Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Tanner and the others became little more than living skeletons. Starvation forced them to resort to [[cannibalism]] as they drew lots to see who would be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]]. As time went by, the initial group of thirty survivors had been reduced to a mere seven, Tanner included, as the others were killed and devoured. During the tenth [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of their self-imprisonment in the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] happened upon the derelict ''Vector'' near the fringes of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Salvage teams, sent to the Star Destroyer to recover parts needed to fix the [[Freighter/Legends|barge's]] inactive [[Engine/Legends|engines]], inadvertently brought the virus back with them to the ''Purge'', where it quickly spread and killed all but a half-dozen aboard. One ''Purge'' survivor, [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]], chanced upon the surviving Imperial personnel within their shuttle as he fled from the undead. The seven attempted to kill and eat Sartoris, but he managed to gain the upper hand, throwing four of the men&mdash;Gorrister included&mdash;into the sea of zombies outside the shuttle.<ref name="DT" />

However, one of the three remaining men, [[White (soldier)|White]], managed to convince Sartoris to let them live and attempt an escape. A plan was formulated in which Sartoris would deactivate the tractor beam preventing the shuttle from leaving, and the remaining survivors&mdash;Tanner, White, and [[Pauling]]&mdash;would help him [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the craft to safety once he returned. Sartoris succeeded in disabling the tractor beam and directed fellow ''Purge'' survivors [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Trig Longo]] to the awaiting craft, before sacrificing himself to ensure that the three made it safely to their destination. Upon the trio's arrival, Tanner greeted them and informed them of White's death. However, as the shuttle began its departure, one of the zombies managed to get aboard; it killed and fed on Tanner and Pauling before it was destroyed.<ref name="DT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It was nothing more than a simple matter of survival. We were ''starving'', you see.|Gorrister, explaining the survivors' cannibalism to Sartoris|<ref name="DT" />}}
An Imperial soldier, Tanner was one of the lucky few to escape from the horde of undead zombies aboard the ''Vector''. In their self-imprisonment aboard the shuttle, the soldiers had plenty of [[Water/Legends|water]] but a limited food supply, and eventually resorted to cannibalism to sustain themselves. Tanner managed to outlast many others, surviving for ten weeks as their numbers dwindled from thirty to seven. In this time, starvation had reduced him to nothing more than a living skeleton; his skin had become shriveled and [[Color/Legends|yellowed]], and his expression was pale. Still, he greeted the trio of survivors from the ''Purge'' with a smile, albeit an unnatural-looking one, given his appearance.<ref name="DT" />

==Equipment==
Tanner wore a black uniform.<ref name="DT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanner appeared in [[Joe Schreiber]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Death Troopers]]''.<ref name="DT" />
